title: The temple steps
subtitle: Everything at once. Catch him for good!

sections.name: TempleStreet
sections.note: The temple street at festival time: the rooster struts ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstSteps
sections.note: The first temple steps: up (walked), along the landing, and down. A feather.

sections.name: HensDung
sections.note: Two of a vendor's hens, then cow dung.

sections.name: Rooftops
sections.note: Up a ladder onto the terraces, a tank, a gap, and down.

sections.name: Neem
sections.note: A neem by the temple, its low limb across the street: slide.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: A breather: mangoes and a chilli.

sections.name: Awnings
sections.note: The flower and brass-vessel stalls: bounce along the awnings. A feather.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: The hand-pump puddle; the rooster knocks a hens' basket into the road; a goat kid.

sections.name: StepsWithPots
sections.note: Temple steps with the festival's new pots stacked on the landing: jump them up there.

sections.name: ChilliLane
sections.note: A chilli to win back ground.

sections.name: Flocks
sections.note: Two hens, a goat kid, the hens' basket; a feather over the basket.

sections.name: RoofsAgain
sections.note: The terraces again.

sections.name: NeemDungSacks
sections.note: The second neem's low limb, cow dung, sacks of paddy unloaded for a shop: hop on and off.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A chilli and a straight.

sections.name: StepsAwnings
sections.note: Temple steps, then a row of stalls.

sections.name: CrowdedStreet
sections.note: Hens, their basket, a heap of building sand, a dog asleep.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: A chilli.

sections.name: LastRoofs
sections.note: The last rooftops.

sections.name: StepsAgain
sections.note: Another flight, the festival's pots on its landing.

sections.name: LastAwnings
sections.note: The last row of stalls.

sections.name: LastTest
sections.note: Everything once more: hens, a goat kid, the puddle, the basket, a hen.

sections.name: TempleApproach
sections.note: The temple's own steps, the last flight.

sections.name: TempleCourt
sections.note: The temple court: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 340 m.
